entries.name: Ambassador’s Sash
entries.narrativeDescription: They’ll follow you if you look pretty!
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0}% more Persuasion Power in Diplomacy.

entries.name: Amelchia’s Law
entries.narrativeDescription: It becomes incredibly hard to do something when the Queen of Alvar forbids it.

entries.name: Ancient Idol
entries.description: The hero ignores the restriction on using the same Magic School twice.
entries.narrativeDescription: Power flows from the idol’s stone eyes, coursing into the body of its owner.

entries.name: Arcane Tome
entries.description: Allows the hero to cast all Arcane spells.
entries.narrativeDescription: “Doreath the Pure, Weaver of the world’s clearest essence, Master of Time, Space, and Solitude…”

entries.name: Armet
entries.narrativeDescription: A modern classic.

entries.name: Armor of Wonder
entries.description: +{0} Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
entries.narrativeDescription: This armor was worn by ancient warriors of the Church of the Sun when it was still in its infancy.

entries.name: Automated Antimagic Shield
entries.narrativeDescription: Dwarves deal with the elements so much, they’ve automated their defenses.

entries.name: Backpack
entries.narrativeDescription: Yes, you can wear it over that fancy cape.

entries.name: Banner of Six Winds
entries.narrativeDescription: There used to be a seventh wind, but he displeased Arina. And then there were six.

entries.name: Beelzebub’s Boon
entries.narrativeDescription: A new force in this world, Beelzebub sought a way to ensure his summoning would never end.

entries.name: Blob of Red
entries.narrativeDescription: Is it blood?

entries.name: Bone Boots
entries.description: +{0} Spell Power, then +{1}% total Spell Power.
entries.narrativeDescription: They whisper in your sleep.

entries.name: Boots of Travel
entries.narrativeDescription: Nothing beats soft leather for travelling long distances.

entries.name: Boreoloth’s Hand
entries.narrativeDescription: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self‑improvement.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Attack. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Boreoloth’s Head
entries.narrativeDescription: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self‑improvement.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Knowledge. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Boreoloth’s Heart
entries.narrativeDescription: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self‑improvement.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Spell Power. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Boreoloth’s Tail
entries.narrativeDescription: Born into a clutch of ordinary dragons, Boreoloth spent his life striving for the greatness he was denied at birth. Even in death, his remains still hold the spark of endless self‑improvement.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Defense. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Brass Knuckles
entries.narrativeDescription: Well, technically it’s four rings.

entries.name: Buckler
entries.description: Friendly creatures can counterattack even if the attacking enemy has “Swift Strike.”
entries.narrativeDescription: Made not for defense, but to better position yourself for counterattacking.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: Friendly creatures deal +{0}% Melee Damage.

entries.name: Caduceus
entries.narrativeDescription: With this, blood can become magic, and matter can become spirit.

entries.name: Celestial Sash of Bliss
entries.description: +{0} Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
entries.narrativeDescription: The sentinels have withdrawn from the pact, but the artifact remains.

entries.name: Chain Link
entries.description: Forbids the wearer and the enemy hero to cast tier‑{0} and {1} spells in combat.
entries.narrativeDescription: A link from a Concubus chain worn around the finger. It’s seen a lot.

entries.name: Chain Mail
entries.narrativeDescription: Basic torso protection. Takes way too long to make for its mediocre defense.

entries.name: Chitinous Shield
entries.narrativeDescription: Their shells are as hard as crystal.

entries.name: Clenching Ring
entries.description: All effects applied by the hero last +{0} round(s).
entries.narrativeDescription: This ring helps one cling to incantations as effortlessly as birds cling to branches in their sleep.

entries.name: Crescent Dagger
entries.description: Spells and creature abilities ignore {0}% of enemy magic resistance.
entries.narrativeDescription: If spells are written in the stars, the crescent moon is there to cut them to pieces.

entries.name: Crimson Resonance Controller
entries.narrativeDescription: Magic is the art of resonance — which means discordant vibration can dampen it.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: –{0}% more to enemy Spell Power.

entries.name: Crown of Dragontooth
entries.narrativeDescription: There’s much wisdom to be found in a dragon’s wisdom teeth.

entries.name: Crown of the Supreme Magi
entries.narrativeDescription: They say it drives the wearer mad over time.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Knowledge. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Dark Hatchet
entries.narrativeDescription: Perfect for mincing meat and not mincing words.

entries.name: Daylight Tome
entries.description: Allows the hero to cast all Daylight spells.
entries.narrativeDescription: “Arina the Brave, Justice of the Heavens, Sister of Sunlight that reveals all and strikes true…”

entries.name: Deck of Spells
entries.description: Makes all tier‑{0} spells available to the hero.
entries.narrativeDescription: Some wizards enjoyed games and gambling a bit too much. This is the result.

entries.name: Demon Claw
entries.narrativeDescription: They say Beelzebub’s hands are soft as silk, but not those of his minions.

entries.name: Demonic Heart
entries.description: Replaces all the hero’s spells with their Masterful versions (if they exist).
entries.narrativeDescription: Everyone has all the power of the world in their heart. You just need to tune to the Chorus’s buzz to find it.

entries.name: Diplomatic Gifts
entries.narrativeDescription: No desire for independence can withstand the power of goodies.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0}% more Persuasion Power in Diplomacy.

entries.name: Dragon Scale Armor
entries.narrativeDescription: The black dragons of Alvar are relatively fine with seeing their green brethren skinned. The ashen dragons of Alvar are completely fine with it.

entries.name: Dragon Scale Shield
entries.narrativeDescription: Some call fashioning arms from dragon hide blasphemy. But such critiques can’t be heard over the sound of its superior protection.

entries.name: Dragon Wing Tabard
entries.narrativeDescription: Zero wings were harmed in the making of this tabard.

entries.name: Dragonbone Greaves
entries.narrativeDescription: Just don’t venture into Alvar, Garrote Gorge, or any other land ruled by dragons wearing them.

entries.name: Drum of War
entries.narrativeDescription: Without cause or purpose.

entries.name: Eagle Armor
entries.narrativeDescription: Spirits and birds soar together.

entries.name: Emerald Resonance Controller
entries.narrativeDescription: Magic is the art of resonance — which means discordant vibration can dampen it.

entries.name: Enchanted Magic Scroll
entries.description: Allows the hero to use a specific spell at its maximum level.
entries.narrativeDescription: Parchment imbued with enough magical knowledge to replicate the power of a master.

entries.name: Endless Bag
entries.description: Produces +{0} Gem, Crystal, or Mercury daily. (The resource depends on the bearer’s faction.)
entries.narrativeDescription: Adventurers all over the world throw their possessions into these bags. It’s about time someone began to fish them out.

entries.name: Excalibur
entries.description: Heroic Strike kills +{0} unit(s). Works on creatures up to tier {1}.
entries.narrativeDescription: No scale, armor, or shield can offer protection against this blade.

entries.name: Fallen Angel Wings
entries.narrativeDescription: They whisper that the true angels abandoned the Temple of the Sun. Was it the Templars’ zealotry — or the angels’ hubris?

entries.name: Fancy Mask
entries.description: Generates {0} Focus Point(s) at the start of the battle.
entries.narrativeDescription: Tell me what mask you wear, and I will tell you who you want to be.

entries.name: Fine Wand
entries.narrativeDescription: Wands are used to focus mental projections, just as crystals focus light into beams.

entries.name: Fish‑to‑the‑Face
entries.narrativeDescription: It goes “wobble wobble” in battle.

entries.name: Flag of Truce
entries.description: The wearer keeps their army whenever they flee from battle.
entries.narrativeDescription: No matter how powerful you are on the battlefield, in the end all disputes are solved politically.

entries.name: Flask of Oblivion
entries.description: All negative effects on friendly creatures last for –{0} round(s).
entries.narrativeDescription: Water brings oblivion. It can erase memories of pain and trouble.

entries.name: Garotte
entries.narrativeDescription: Can’t do much when you’re choking.

entries.name: Golden Goose Egg
entries.description: Grants a random wondrous reward after a random number of upgrades.
entries.narrativeDescription: If we knew for certain how golden geese are hatched, we’d live like kings. But there doesn’t seem to be a pattern.

entries.name: Golden Moth
entries.narrativeDescription: They say moths burn themselves mistaking light for gold, for such is their attraction to riches. And so for her husband’s greed, Duke Milos’s wife was turned into a moth.

entries.name: Golden Pig
entries.narrativeDescription: They say pigs are so greedy they dig the ground constantly in search for gold. And so for his own greed, Duke Milos was turned into a pig.

entries.name: Head Torch
entries.narrativeDescription: Surprisingly, it was the templars who invented it, not the dwarves. They required even more of the guiding light.

entries.name: Heartbeat
entries.narrativeDescription: Just feel the rhythm of the Chorus.

entries.name: Helm of Heavenly Enlightenment
entries.description: +{0} Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
entries.narrativeDescription: Many say this is the helm of Erathia’s founder, but could it be possible for it to have ended up on Jadame?

entries.name: Holy Sigil of Eridore
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Logistics, Battle Magic, Wisdom.
entries.narrativeDescription: A fictional deity invented by pixies as a prank, Eridore would later be worshipped by many seeking to bless their messages.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of Insara
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Leadership, Insight, Diplomacy, Tactics.
entries.narrativeDescription: Legend speaks of an oracle who could foresee the outcomes of wars and battles. Over time, generals began to revere her name.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of Mearea
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Luck, Economy, Daylight Magic.
entries.narrativeDescription: The golden dragon of myth is said to bring wealth so great that it eventually became a symbol of worship.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of Quix
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Arcane Magic, Scouting, Battlecraft, Thaumaturgy.
entries.narrativeDescription: A conqueror who was said to have never died, but instead ventured to conquer new worlds beyond this one, Quix exists now only in legend.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of Roph
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Righteousness, Necromancy, Murmuring, Triumvirate’s Strength, Abyssal Communion, Summon Swarm.
entries.narrativeDescription: No one remembers who Roph once served, but he did so with unwavering loyalty. In time, he became a local saint, embodying the ideals of steadfast devotion to one’s sovereign, one’s faction, and oneself.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of The Second Man
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Offense, Summon Avatar, Siegecraft, Combat.
entries.narrativeDescription: The First Man in existence is said to have found death, conquered by the power of the Second. At least, that is what the legends tell.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of The Seven Magi
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Sorcery, Nightshade Magic, Resistance.
entries.narrativeDescription: Seven powerful mages formed a secret coven. It’s no longer in existence, but their Sigil endures.

entries.name: Holy Sigil of Uurdt
entries.description: While worn, grants all unlearned Subskills of the following Skills: Defense, Primal Magic, Recruitment.
entries.narrativeDescription: “Where blood spills, plants grow.” This was the motto of an ancient druidic cult, and only their sigil remains to tell their tale.

entries.name: Iridescent Cloak
entries.narrativeDescription: Murmurwood casters rarely read, relying instead on memory for their mystical knowledge.

entries.name: Keeper’s Amulet
entries.narrativeDescription: This amulet allows the wearer to survive against all odds — though sadly, it’s worn by cowards who never intend to face such dangers.

entries.name: Keeper’s Ring
entries.narrativeDescription: City guards often wear these rings to help them react to danger one or two seconds faster.

entries.name: Lance
entries.narrativeDescription: Charge!

entries.name: Last Coin
entries.narrativeDescription: It’s always heads.

entries.name: Legion’s Leg
entries.description: +{0}% to all creature growth in all your cities.
entries.narrativeDescription: Somewhere, a legless statue is waiting sorrowfully.

entries.name: Lifeblood Fae
entries.narrativeDescription: The fae know unique blood magic. They also remember the face of everyone who has ever held them captive.

entries.name: Light‑and‑Shade Cloak
entries.description: Friendly creatures can still use Ranged attacks while adjacent to enemy creatures.
entries.narrativeDescription: Makes the wearer dissolve into the dance of light and shade.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: Friendly creatures deal +{0}% Ranged Damage.

entries.name: Lion’s Shield of Courage
entries.description: +{0} Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
entries.narrativeDescription: In Jadame, the Alliance’s effect extends to all creatures, not just those part of the initial pact.

entries.name: Liquid Silence
entries.description: +{0} round(s) to the cooldown of all enemy creature abilities.
entries.narrativeDescription: A common tool of negotiation in Alvar court.

entries.name: Lord’s Ring
entries.narrativeDescription: When your lord commands, you get up and go. Simple as that.

entries.name: Magic Key Ring
entries.description: Negates all effects that restrict creature rearrangement, surrendering, fleeing, and using the Spellbook and hero abilities in battle.
entries.narrativeDescription: Can unlock the Shackles of War.

entries.name: Magic Mirror
entries.description: Restores {0} mana to the hero each morning.
entries.narrativeDescription: This mirror has an uncanny ability to restore its own broken shards.

entries.name: Magic Scroll
entries.description: Allows the hero to use a specific spell.
entries.narrativeDescription: Parchment imbued with magical knowledge.

entries.name: Magic Slippers
entries.narrativeDescription: Not the most comfortable, but definitely very magical.

entries.name: Mirror Tiara
entries.description: Restores {0} mana to the hero each morning.
entries.narrativeDescription: When crafted into jewelry and worn near the head, tranquil glass reveals its true power.

entries.name: Misericorde
entries.narrativeDescription: Ending an opponent’s suffering swiftly is a mercy.

entries.name: Monster Head
entries.description: All creatures always have neutral Morale in battle.
entries.narrativeDescription: Can’t be too cheerful when the opponent flaunts their trophies like that.

entries.name: Music Sheet
entries.narrativeDescription: Music helps one articulate themselves — and sets the battle rhythm.

entries.name: Mythic Magic Scroll
entries.description: Allows the hero to use a special global map spell.
entries.narrativeDescription: Parchment imbued with magical knowledge capable of overcoming distance itself.

entries.name: Nightshade Tome
entries.description: Allows the hero to cast all Nightshade spells.
entries.narrativeDescription: “Naira the True, the Gentle, Knower of Secrets, Muffler of Steps: wrap me in your wings of silence…”

entries.name: Ogre’s Club of Havoc
entries.narrativeDescription: Coincidentally, the ogres of Ironsand also have a club where they wreak havoc.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Attack. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Omencaller
entries.narrativeDescription: An imp on your shoulder spells bad luck… for the enemy.

entries.name: Orb of Dawn
entries.description: All of the hero’s Daylight spells have +{0} level(s). Enemy hero has –{0} Daylight spell level.
entries.narrativeDescription: Daylight magic is relentless, excelling in positive effects, cleansing, defense, and attack.

entries.name: Orb of Destruction
entries.narrativeDescription: It will take all that you are and turn it into raw power.

entries.name: Orb of Eternity
entries.description: All of the hero’s Arcane spells have +{0} level(s). Enemy hero has –{0} Arcane spell level.
entries.narrativeDescription: Arcane magic is elusive, capable of bending time, space, and raw energy to its will.

entries.name: Orb of Inhibition
entries.description: On the first round of the battle, heroes cannot use their Spellbook or active abilities.
entries.narrativeDescription: It’s strange to behold, as though within this orb light and sound do not exist.

entries.name: Orb of Twilight
entries.description: All of the hero’s Nightshade spells have +{0} level(s). Enemy hero has –{0} Nightshade spell level.
entries.narrativeDescription: Nightshade magic is subtle, specializing in negative effects, mind‑reading, and manipulation.

entries.name: Pelagic Hourglass
entries.description: The cooldowns of all spells are reduced by {0} round(s).
entries.narrativeDescription: Water flows upwards, rewinding time.

entries.name: Phoenix Egg
entries.description: Something has halted the phoenix’s rebirth.
entries.narrativeDescription: A silence where fire should rise.

entries.name: Plate Armor
entries.narrativeDescription: Sticks and stones may break bones, but not through full armor.

entries.name: Pole Star
entries.description: Global Map spells of the hero cost {0} mana.
entries.narrativeDescription: They say stars are the tears of heaven. And tears can be drunk.

entries.name: Primal Tome
entries.description: Allows the hero to cast all Primal spells.
entries.narrativeDescription: “Hksmilla, World’s Rage, Primal Eye; unlike any other scholar, with your thousand claws and multiple heads...”

entries.name: Primordial Orb
entries.description: All of the hero’s Primal spells have +{0} level(s). Enemy hero has –{0} Primal spell level.
entries.narrativeDescription: Primal magic is raw and untamed, focusing mostly on elemental assaults.

entries.name: Protective Belt
entries.narrativeDescription: Not to be confused with conveyor belts. (Unless…)

entries.name: Quiet Eye of a Dragon
entries.narrativeDescription: You can’t shake the feeling that it follows you wherever you go.

entries.name: Quivering Quiver
entries.narrativeDescription: Grows magic arrows, bolts, darts, shuriken, javelins, and any throwing item imaginable. (Thank the woods.)

entries.name: Rags
entries.narrativeDescription: Don’t judge what makes others feel empowered!

entries.name: Rapier
entries.narrativeDescription: A light, stinging weapon. A tool for elegant fighters.

entries.name: Red Dragon Flame Tongue
entries.narrativeDescription: Forged with the breath of a true dragon.

entries.name: Ribcage Armor
entries.narrativeDescription: Honestly, it’s not that much deader than a reanimated skeleton.

entries.name: Ring of Life
entries.description: All positive effects on friendly creatures last for +{0} round(s).
entries.narrativeDescription: Made of silverwort, a unique herb that feels like metal.

entries.name: Ring of Neutrality
entries.description: All creatures always have neutral Luck in battle.
entries.narrativeDescription: Chances can be calculated — and neutralized.

entries.name: Robe of Enlightenment
entries.description: Makes all tier‑{0} spells available to the hero.
entries.narrativeDescription: A wizard once noticed an odd resemblance between weaving and spellcraft. As a result, these robes were created.

entries.name: Rope Belt
entries.narrativeDescription: Protects the important bits.

entries.name: Runestone Shards
entries.description: Makes all tier‑{0} spells available to the hero.
entries.narrativeDescription: Just these few shards hold vast knowledge, suggesting they may have once been part of something much greater.

entries.name: Sandals of the Saint
entries.description: +{0} Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
entries.narrativeDescription: Many are the pilgrims of the Light who wear these sandals as a gesture of humility.

entries.name: Scholar’s Amulet
entries.narrativeDescription: For those who know that they know nothing.

entries.name: Scholar’s Tiara
entries.narrativeDescription: To mark those willing to learn — and to aid them in doing so.

entries.name: Seal of Silence
entries.description: +{0} round(s) to the cooldown of all enemy spells.
entries.narrativeDescription: It does more than prevent speech; it saps the very desire to resist.

entries.name: Second Shade
entries.narrativeDescription: It has an eerie aura of thinking for you.

entries.name: Seven Eyes
entries.description: +{0} level(s) to all spells while worn.
entries.narrativeDescription: Connecting directly to the brain, these eyes access an entirely new layer of knowledge.

entries.name: Seven‑League Boots
entries.narrativeDescription: A little month; or ere those shoes grew old. And their trail stretched long.

entries.name: Shackles of War
entries.description: Prevents surrender and flee in battle. (This effects both the wearer and their opponent.)
entries.narrativeDescription: Should have gone with the Lasso of War to catch the mount, too.

entries.name: Shaman Staff
entries.narrativeDescription: The focusing gem isn’t crafted but naturally grown on the branch.

entries.name: Shard of Serenity
entries.description: Restores {0} mana to the hero each morning.
entries.narrativeDescription: A ring crafted from a stray shard of tranquil glass retains some of its calming properties.

entries.name: Shield of the Rampaging Ogre
entries.narrativeDescription: ...Why would a rampaging ogre need a shield?
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Defense. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Shoddy Shield
entries.narrativeDescription: It may be just a plank of wood, but at least it’s sturdy wood.

entries.name: Shroomwood Bow
entries.description: Eliminates Ranged Damage penalty for friendly creatures.
entries.narrativeDescription: This living bow grows new arrows itself.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: Friendly creatures deal +{0}% Ranged Damage.

entries.name: Singing Pan‑Pipe
entries.description: All effects applied by friendly creatures last +{0} round(s).
entries.narrativeDescription: Spells linger like notes.

entries.name: Sirin Mask
entries.description: The cooldowns of all spells are reduced by {0} round(s).
entries.narrativeDescription: Owls and sirins know everything — whether they choose to share it is another matter.

entries.name: Sixth Finger
entries.narrativeDescription: King Elloran was said to have cursed touch. Even now his finger brings misfortune, so long as you let it grow into your hand.

entries.name: Skull of Milos
entries.narrativeDescription: They say gold doesn’t care if you’re guilty or innocent. And so for his master’s greed Duke Milos’s most loyal servant was imprisoned in a golden skull.

entries.name: Slithering Sash
entries.narrativeDescription: The eye may be fake, crafted from a jewel, but the slithering is very much real.

entries.name: Soulcaller Ring
entries.description: The enemy loses {0} levels on all Magic School spells.
entries.narrativeDescription: Summoned from beyond the veil, they gladly aid in supressing your enemies — for they know that one day it will be your turn to repay their price.

entries.name: Soulless Sash
entries.narrativeDescription: As opposed to all the other sashes that are so notorious for having souls.

entries.name: Spellbinder’s Hat
entries.description: Makes all tier‑{0} spells available to the hero.
entries.narrativeDescription: Legendary among wizards, this hat is the dream of every mage on Enroth.

entries.name: Spells in Bottles
entries.description: Makes all tier‑{0} spells available to the hero.
entries.narrativeDescription: Potions have existed for a long time, but to bottle the very knowledge needed to cast a spell? That is truly an impressive feat.

entries.name: Spyglass
entries.narrativeDescription: I spy with my little eye something beginning with the eye of a storm.

entries.name: Straw Hat
entries.narrativeDescription: The fool is sometimes the smartest man in the village.

entries.name: Swamp Boots
entries.narrativeDescription: They also work as Snow Boots, Desert Boots, Deathland Boots, etc.

entries.name: Sword of Judgement
entries.description: +{0} Attack, Defense, Spell Power, and Knowledge.
entries.narrativeDescription: The Angelic Alliance was formed as a symbol of unity between sentinels of glory and mortals. Rumor has is that other such alliances exist in far away lands.

entries.name: Tabar Signet‑Ring
entries.narrativeDescription: “Tabar” means “novelty” in the Sacred Vori Language. Combined, “Ukhtabar” means “the joy of novelty.”

entries.name: Tactical Guide
entries.description: The opponent cannot rearrange creatures before the start of battle.
entries.narrativeDescription: 22… Ra4 23. Nc3 Ra8 24. Nb5 Ra4 25. Nc3 Ra8 26. Nb5.

entries.name: Truthmaker
entries.narrativeDescription: Truth is what you make it. And if reality doesn’t agree, remind it who’s the strongest here.

entries.name: Truthseeker
entries.narrativeDescription: To find out the truth, first find their softest, most vulnerable spot.

entries.name: Tunic of the Cyclops King
entries.narrativeDescription: This is where his second eye is.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: +{0} more Spell Power. Can be upgraded an unlimited number of times.

entries.name: Two‑faced Mask
entries.description: The hero can use the Spellbook {0} additional time(s) per battle round.
entries.narrativeDescription: The inscription reads, “Divide your visage, and you shall never face battle alone.”

entries.name: Ukh Signet
entries.narrativeDescription: “Ukh” means “joy” in the Sacred Vori Language. Combined, “Ukhtabar” means “the joy of novelty.”

entries.name: Voodoo Doll
entries.description: When the wearer is defeated, they can still be hired back in the Tavern.
entries.narrativeDescription: And what a lovely community awaits them there!

entries.name: Vortex Robe
entries.description: Whenever the opponent casts a spell, restores {0}% of its cost as mana to the wearer.
entries.narrativeDescription: If you look at it for too long, you’ll feel as though it’s sucking you in.
entries.upgradeDescription: Upgrade: Restores {0}% of the spell’s cost.

entries.name: Warlord Boots
entries.narrativeDescription: Can’t stand in one place — need to act!

entries.name: Warrior’s Amulet
entries.narrativeDescription: The mark of many martial feats accomplished — and many more to come.

entries.name: Warrior’s Belt
entries.narrativeDescription: Any warrior can appreciate a good belt to hang their sword on.

entries.name: Wizard’s Amulet
entries.narrativeDescription: Even if the wearer is lacking, the power within this amulet more than compensates for it.

entries.name: Wizard’s Cloak
entries.narrativeDescription: It magically blocks out distractions, allowing the wizard to focus solely on their spellcraft.

entries.name: Wooden Ring
entries.narrativeDescription: A peasant’s only treasure.
